subject: Penpot PNG probe 04 — MCP 2.13.3 connected
body: Run the deterministic Penpot export probe immediately against the current @penpot/mcp@2.13.3 runtime while the Penpot plugin is visibly already connected. Do not use LLM tool planning. Call export_shape for shapeId page and format png. Do not mutate the design. Return exact MCP/plugin/export text plus image_count, visual_source, visual_fallback_error, result_content_types, and visual_diagnostics.
